title: Which One? 离 vs 从, 的时候 vs 以后, 之间 vs 中间, 人家
description: B1 contrast practice: distance vs starting point, during vs after, between vs middle, and the many meanings of 人家.

points.title: 离 vs 从
points.summary: 离 (lí) = distance from (A 离 B 很近, 离考试还有三天). 从 (cóng) = starting point of a movement or time (从…到…).
points.body:
- **从**这儿到火车站要多长时间?
- 现在**离**考试还有三天.
examples: There are three days left until the exam.

points.title: 的时候 vs 以后
points.summary: …的时候 = while / when (at the same time). …以后 = after (it's finished).
points.body:
- 我小**的时候**住在农村.
- 到了北京**以后**，给我发个短信.
examples: When I was little I lived in the countryside.

points.title: 之间 vs 中间
points.summary: 之间 (zhījiān) always follows two (or more) things: 我们之间, A 和 B 之间. 中间 (zhōngjiān) can stand alone: 坐在中间 (sit in the middle).
points.body:
- 我们**之间**没有秘密.
- 请坐在**中间**.
examples: There are no secrets between us.

points.title: 人家: others / that person / I
points.summary: 人家 (rénjia) usually means 'other people' (like 别人) — but said playfully about yourself it means 'I'.
points.body:
- **人家**都去了，你为什么不去? (Everyone else went …)
- **人家**不想去嘛! (I don't want to go! — sulky, playful)
examples: Everyone else went — why aren't you going?

notes: 在这儿到 isn't the pattern.
离 doesn't pair with 到.
questions.translation: How long does it take from here to the train station?

questions.prompt: {现在|xiànzài}（　）{考试|kǎoshì}{还有|háiyǒu}{三|sān}{天|tiān}，{我|wǒ}{得|děi}{好好|hǎohǎo}{复习|fùxí}。
notes: 到考试还有 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: There are three days left until the exam — I need to revise properly.

notes: 小以后 doesn't work — childhood doesn't 'finish' at a point.
questions.translation: When I was little I lived in the countryside.

notes: Before arriving you can't report arriving.
后来 can't follow a verb.
questions.translation: Text me after you get to Beijing.

questions.prompt: {我们|wǒmen}{是|shì}{最|zuì}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{朋友|péngyou}，{我们|wǒmen}（　）{没有|méiyǒu}{秘密|mìmì}。
notes: 中间 = the middle (a position) — not 'between people'.
questions.translation: We're best friends — there are no secrets between us.

questions.prompt: {你|nǐ}{个子|gèzi}{不|bù}{高|gāo}，{照相|zhàoxiàng}{的|de}{时候|shíhou}{站|zhàn}{在|zài}（　）{吧|ba}。
notes: 之间 needs two things before it.
questions.translation: You're not tall — stand in the middle for the photo.

questions.prompt: In 「{人家|rénjia}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{为什么|wèishénme}{不|bú}{去|qù}？」, who is 人家?
notes: Here 人家 contrasts with 你 — it's the others.
That's the playful use — not here.
questions.translation: Everyone else went — why aren't you going?

questions.prompt: Said in a sulky, playful tone, who doesn't want to go in 「{人家|rénjia}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{嘛|ma}！」?
notes: In this tone 人家 means 'I'.
